findings.body:
On a deployment that binds WORKER_AGENTS, startNamedAttemptUnchecked sends a boot without claude_sub to startHostedAttempt whenever the agent's state is absent. A claude-sub container job never has an agent, so its state is always absent. Once the job outlives LEASE_TTL_MS (2h), the sticky lease has lapsed. A re-Start of the same attempt (orchestrator restart or adoption) that finds every subscription busy then steps down and starts a hosted worker on the same container name beside the running claude worker. It also overwrites the boot record's harness with pi-durable, which moves the state route and the reclaim to the agent. Separately, a lapsed lease lets the pool exceed its per-subscription cap while the job still runs. Fix: before routing, consult the recorded boot (deps.boots); an unsettled boot whose harness is not the hosted kind goes to startContainerAttempt and adopts. Also consider renewing the lease while its job is running.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts:725-766 (routing keyed on boot.claude_sub and agent state only); cloudflare/src/claude-sub.ts:107 LEASE_TTL_MS and :331 sticky lease bounded by the TTL
findings.title: Hosted re-Start of a claude job past its lease TTL boots a rival worker

findings.body:
The step-down is covered by the parity guard (static) and by a fake httptest door on the Go side, but no test drives the real door through it. A scratch test confirmed it works: hosted harness, fill MAX1's cap with two claude/sonnet starts, and the third start comes back as pi-durable/workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3 and is accepted by the real executor. Commit it beside TestTheRealDoorRunsAClaudeSubJobOnAHostedDeployment, asserting the handle, the record, one agent started, and no new lease. Lowering the cap through a harness binding (CLAUDE_SUB_MAX_CONCURRENT=1) would keep it to two starts.
evidence: internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/claude_sub_e2e_test.go (leased path only); internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/model_test.go TestASteppedDownRungDispatchStartsAndRecordsThePairThatRan (fake door)
findings.title: Real-door Go test for the hosted claude-sub step-down

findings.body:
The stuck watch and the steer route live in the WorkerAgent. A claude-sub job on a hosted deployment runs in its own container with no agent, so a steer gets 409 not_conversing and nothing nudges or stops a silent claude worker before its wall or harness_budget_ms. Either watch container jobs from the state route's log cursor, or make the Go side's watch treat not_conversing on a rung job as expected.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-dispatch.ts:921 steerAgent; cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts startContainerAttempt (no stuck_seconds consumer)
findings.title: Stuck watch and steer for claude-sub container jobs on a hosted deployment

findings.body:
bw7 was reported from yhe attempt 8's base e5b155f, which does not contain the y38 merge 008fce3cf. In the integrated tree, executor.go's bootedOnTheResolvedModelOrTheRungsDeclaredFallback accepts the rung's declared step-down pair. A real-door run (hosted, cap full) shows the stepped-down pi-durable/glm-5.3 handle accepted by the Go executor.
evidence: internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/executor.go:527-539; git merge-base --is-ancestor 008fce3cf e5b155fed -> false
findings.title: bw7 is already fixed in the integrated tree by y38; close it
